_comment: 4-channel kitchen timer, two fixed fingers, one servo per button, no pan: servo 0 is on H, servo 1 on ST/SP. Every other button has no finger, so it's reachable false and the planner never sees it. Screens stay reachable, the camera reads them. ST/SP's angles are still null (Pam fills them Sunday), so pressing it fails with NotCalibrated until then. Every press holds for hold_ms (a control can override it with its own hold_ms), and nothing over max_hold_ms is pressed. Control ids match vision/calibration/timer-01.boxes.json. Anything in the notes marked UNVERIFIED hasn't been checked on the real timer.
notes: Four channels, T1 to T4. Each has its own LCD row (screen_t1 to screen_t4) showing HH:MM SS, so 02:00 00 is 2 hours and 00:05 00 is 5 minutes.
The rig has only two fingers: one on H, one on ST/SP. T1 to T4, M, S, 10M, 5M, 10S and RESET can't be pressed, so they aren't in the controls.

T1 is the picked channel after power-on (checked on the rig), and the rig can't press T1 to T4 to pick another one. So every plan works on T1 and verifies on screen_t1. A request for T2, T3 or T4 can't be done.
Only whole hours can be set (H is the only time button the rig can press). A request for minutes or seconds can't be done.

H adds 1 hour to the picked channel per press (checked on the rig: 20 presses on T1 read 20:00 00). Press H one step at a time (count 1) and expect the new time after each press, so a missed press shows up right away.
Every press on this timer is a 1 s hold (hold_ms 1000): a 250 ms tap doesn't click, and 2 s or longer makes the button auto-repeat.
UNVERIFIED: what H does past 23 hours.
UNVERIFIED: what pressing T1 to T4 shows (a flashing row or digit).

No finger on these yet, for later: M and S add 1 minute or 1 second per press (UNVERIFIED, and what happens past 59). 10M, 5M and 10S add 10 minutes, 5 minutes or 10 seconds to the time already set rather than setting it to that value (UNVERIFIED).

No finger on this yet, for later: RESET clears the picked channel. UNVERIFIED: it clears to 00:00 00 (not back to the last set time), and whether it works on a running channel or needs ST/SP to stop it first.
ST/SP starts the picked channel, or stops it if it is running.
UNVERIFIED: a started channel counts down from the set time (so 02:00 00 reads 01:59 59 a second later), and what it does at 00:00 00 (beeps, counts up).
To check a channel really started, expect the time it shows after it has started counting (for 2 hours, expect 01:59), never the time that was set: that is on screen even if ST/SP did nothing.
Approval: the step that presses ST/SP gets requires_approval true with a reason (it starts or stops a channel). Pressing H needs no approval.
